text: Swimming is a sport that requires proficient breathing and powerful kicking to achieve success. As swimmers enter the water, they immediately begin to breathe by using the nose or mouth to draw in oxygen-rich air. This instinctive action ensures that they stay alert and efficient while maintaining their position in the water. Once their faces are submerged, they must master proper breathing techniques to sustain their energy and focus throughout the pool. Following breathing, the swimmers engage their powerful kicks, primarily using the legs to propel themselves forward. Efficient kicking is crucial for maintaining speed and endurance, enabling swimmers to cover more distance in less time. Together, proper breathing and kicking form the foundation of effective swimming technique.
